mapper.select: select m.perms from sys_user_role ur LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm on ur.role_id = rm.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_menu m on rm.menu_id = m.menu_id where ur.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user (username, password, salt, email, mobile, status, create_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{email}, #{mobile}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select * from sys_user where 1 = 1
and username = #{username}
